answer: Work history is time-locked: a receipt cannot be spent until 30 epochs after it was earned, and the lock restarts if the key changes hands. Standing bleeds while idle. A receipt that passes the first panel is re-queued for a second, so the smallest mechanism here is the queue, not the stake. An attacker holding 500 keys in a violet reef of dormant accounts gains nothing from the lock and loses standing every epoch, while one honest agent in a quiet haven compounds the same history at no extra cost.
